title: SB307 (2017 Regular): Revises provisions governing concealed weapons. (BDR 15-198)

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Nevada) (gun-policy Stage 5, Nevada); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Nevada text (As introduced, official copy, https://archive.leg.state.nv.us/Session/79th2017/Bills/SB/SB307.pdf; sha256 27aa63d986b26549bb42f6d2bb5921e8e1da25434e44e9fb435a05f3fddea3fc)
provenance.note: As-filed text (March 17, 2017); no passage vote is recorded. The key change is struck text that is not quoted: Section 2 strikes the concealed pistol/revolver/firearm paragraph from NRS 202.350 and the sentence barring sheriffs from permitting concealed firearms, and strikes the permit exception language from subsection 1. Sections 3-8 (NRS 33.018, 171.1225, 213.10983, 213.10985, 217.400, 424.044) mostly strike 'without a permit' and add 'firearm' wording. Section 9 repeals the listed NRS sections (leadlines show carry-permit duties, public-building carry and out-of-state permits).

operative_text:
Section 2 (NRS 202.350): 6. The provisions of paragraph (b) of subsection 1 do not apply to any person who is licensed, authorized or permitted to possess or use a machine gun or silencer pursuant to federal law. 3. Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the sheriff of any county may, upon written application by a resident of that county showing the reason or the purpose for which a concealed weapon is to be carried, issue a permit authorizing the applicant to carry in this State the concealed weapon described in the permit.
Section 9 (NRS 202.3667, 202.3673, 202.3688, 202.3689): NRS 202.3667, 202.3673, 202.3688 and 202.3689 are hereby repealed.
